environment_caveats: Audited the Cloudflare Pages staging preview because clients/coastal-restoration-services.json has domain: null and no apex_cutover.completed_at. Verified x-robots-tag: noindex is present on the preview, so the Lighthouse SEO category (69 on every URL, is-crawlable scoring 0) is inconclusive and was excluded from all verdicts. Re-audit after apex cutover.

Lighthouse ran DESKTOP only (formFactor=desktop, cpuSlowdownMultiplier=1, throughputKbps=10240). Mobile scores would typically land 10-20 performance points lower. Do not read these as mobile-first scores.

DataForSEO on-page reports has_micromarkup: false on all six URLs. Manually verified against the rendered HTML that JSON-LD IS present (Organization, WebSite, LocalBusiness, Service, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList). Treated as a vendor false negative for JSON-LD and NOT reported as a missing-schema issue.

The named MCP tools on_page_lighthouse and on_page_instant_pages are not exposed by this DataForSEO MCP build. Used authenticated REST calls to /v3/on_page/lighthouse/live/json and /v3/on_page/instant_pages, piped to disk. Equivalent data, same cost basis.
Client record status is 'onboarding', not 'active'. Proceeded because build_status is pushed_main and all six URLs returned HTTP 200, so the site is live and auditable.
Issue IDs prefixed rankai_ are Rank AI derived checks, not Lighthouse or DataForSEO audit IDs. All unprefixed IDs are genuine vendor IDs.
